probes.question: What percentage year-over-year growth in contactless payments did the TechPayment Solutions industry report indicate?
verbatim: September 10, 2023, saw the release of an industry report by TechPayment Solutions, which indicated a 75% year-over-year growth in contactless payments.

probes.question: What is the purpose of the fingerprint scanner on the contactless cards PaySecure launched?
probes.answer: The fingerprint scanner is there to authenticate transactions.
verbatim: PaySecure launched a line of contactless cards equipped with a fingerprint scanner to authenticate transactions.
